mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuation models and increasing the present value of future cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0% and the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the annualized CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized rate exceeds 3.0% and the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline and the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average and the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, which lowers near-term corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1200.0 and the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals aggressive monetary tightening in response to high inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increase and the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong economic growth (GDPC1 annualized growth > 3.0%), the S&P 500 tends to experience positive forward returns as corporate earnings expand, but this effect is most pronounced in the early stages of an expansion cycle.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 3.0% and the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
